description: A legacy inventory application has been containerized but fails to start because it relies on hardcoded internal DNS hostnames. The app expects to connect to 'db.inventory.local', 'cache.inventory.local', and 'auth.provider.external'. You must modify the 'docker-compose.yml' at '/home/ga/legacy-migration/' to configure network aliases for the postgres, redis, and mock-auth services so the application can resolve these hostnames. The source code is immutable; you must fix this via infrastructure configuration. Verify the fix by ensuring the 'legacy-app' container runs successfully and logs 'All systems go!'.
